other_conditions: The family must not own a pucca house in any part of the country.
The family must consist of husband/wife and unmarried children.
The residence must be in a town or city that is covered under the scheme.
The family must not have previously availed benefits of any other government housing-related schemes.
Applicants and family members must have an Aadhaar or Aadhaar Virtual ID.
benefits_summary: Provides interest subsidies and affordable housing to eligible urban households (EWS, LIG, MIG‑1, MIG‑2) through the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme.
